crossRefs.note: You will seek me, and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness…
As Yahweh your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent to seek you. When they said, ‘He is…
They said to him, “See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men. Please let them go and seek your master.…
When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, “Send them.” Therefore they sent fifty men; and they searched for…
For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’ ”
“Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ,’ or, ‘There,’ don’t believe it.
For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead…
I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”
His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
“No more will there be an infant who only lives a few days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child…
When I tell the wicked, ‘You will surely die;’ and you give him no warning, nor speak to warn the wicked from his…
Yet if you warn the wicked, and he doesn’t turn from his wickedness, nor from his wicked way, he will die in his…
The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.
If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
You will seek me, and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”
Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am…
Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared…
These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

translations.web: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”
translations.bsb: Again He said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for Me, but you will die in your sin. Where I am going, you cannot come.”
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus again unto them, I go my way, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sins: whither I go, ye cannot come.
translations.asv: He said therefore again unto them, I go away, and ye shall seek me, and shall die in your sin: whither I go, ye cannot come.
